prompts.tiles: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production pixel-art tileset sheet for a top-down RPG hallway. The attached image is the visual reference only; reconstruct its muted olive-brown horizontal floorboards, faded dusty burgundy carpet, dark grey-brown wall panels, antique stone/brass threshold and blackish side trim. Exact layout: 4 columns by 2 rows of equal square cells, edge to edge with NO spacing, labels or margins. Row 1: (1) seamless horizontal aged olive-brown wood planks with dark seams and very sparse grain, (2) seamless faded dusty burgundy carpet with subtle tiny darker scuffs and no border, (3) matching burgundy carpet with a narrow darker vertical border ONLY on LEFT edge, (4) matching carpet with narrow darker vertical border ONLY on RIGHT edge. Row 2: (1) dark grey-brown vertical outer wall trim with pale stone inner edge, (2) dark taupe/grey-brown wall panel, vertical molding, (3) burgundy carpet bottom edge with dark horizontal hem, (4) grey-olive threshold with fine antique brass line. Every cell fully opaque, fills its full cell, hard square pixel edges. Restrained 16-bit RPG material texture matching the reference closely, no orange wood, no gold rug ornament, no modern shiny finish. Designed to reduce to 16x16 pixels per cell. The output is ONLY this 8-tile atlas, not a room illustration.
prompts.door: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated pixel game sprite, a museum entrance door. Reference image is style and object reference. Re-create the reference hallway's tall rectangular closed GREY wooden door with three recessed panels, darker stone-grey rectangular frame, small aged brass handle on the left. Straight front-facing 16-bit RPG view, slight view of threshold at bottom. Dark grey green/taupe palette, subdued highlights, strongly outlined chunky pixels, restrained dither. No arch, no orange wood, no fantasy carvings, no text, no surroundings. Transparent background, tight object framing. Intended displayed size 64x88 game pixels, readable simple details.
prompts.lamp: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated pixel-art furnishing sprite for a museum game. Reference is the original hallway; faithfully reinterpret ONE of its warm golden yellow table lamps on a small grey olive stone wall shelf with a black curled iron support bracket beneath. Bulbous pleated golden shade, bright yellow small cap, warm brass base. Orthographic front view with slight top-down view of shelf, 16-bit chunky pixel art, crisp edges and stippled light. Lamp and scroll bracket together, transparent background, tightly framed, no background glow or floor, no text. Muted antique materials except warm yellow lamplight. Intended displayed size 28x48 pixels.
prompts.mirror: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one new isolated pixel-art LinkedIn mirror exhibit for a top-down museum game. Reference image is visual style reference. Simple whimsical 16-bit RPG sprite, visible large pixels, limited palette, dark outlines, warm muted wood and brilliant cyan glass. Slight top-down front view. Transparent background, tightly cropped around object, no text, no symbols, no floor or glow. Intended displayed size 28x40 pixels.
